market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a former governor (2014–2018) and prominent Democratic Party figure in the region, making him a plausible candidate for the 2026 gubernatorial race. Even with uncertain nomination and a competitive general election, his true chances are likely in the single-digit percentages, far above the 0.8% implied by the market. The market appears to undervalue his chances significantly.
evidence_points: Yang Seung-jo served as Governor of Chungcheongnam Province from 2014 to 2018, giving him high name recognition.
He remains active in the Democratic Party and has represented the region in the National Assembly, positioning him as a potential candidate.
South Chungcheong is a swing province; a former governor from the major opposition party would likely start with a non-negligible chance of winning if nominated.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of South Korean politics and Yang Seung-jo's career
